tagline: Deep navy with cyan-mint and magenta neon glow, faint grid lines and drifting particle dots, in Sora and DM Sans (spec: Clash Display / Satoshi from Fontshare, swapped for Google Fonts).

palette.description: midnight navy with mint-cyan primary glow and magenta secondary glow

typography.style: sharp contemporary display grotesque with a neutral geometric body

best_for: Technology launches and developer talks that want a nocturnal, glowing look. Cyan carries structure and numbers, magenta marks the secondary signal.
avoid_for: Conservative audiences or printed handouts, where glow effects disappear.
name: Neon Cyber
